name: booking-brief
title: Environment booking brief
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM bookings ORDER BY name

sections.title: Conflicts
sections.sql: SELECT instance,booking_a,booking_b,overlap_start,overlap_end FROM booking_conflicts WHERE booking_a_id=$1 OR booking_b_id=$1

name: handover
title: Environment handover
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM bookings ORDER BY name

sections.title: Handover record
sections.sql: SELECT name,project,owner,status,resolution FROM bookings WHERE id=$1
sections.note: A draft until the operator records test results, reset work and the next owner.

sections.title: Outstanding work
sections.sql: SELECT i.name instance,x.name,x.owner,x.due_date,x.status FROM issues x JOIN instances i ON i.id=x.instance_id WHERE x.instance_id IN(SELECT instance_id FROM booking_instances WHERE booking_id=$1) ORDER BY x.due_date

name: evidence-review
title: Test environment evidence review
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM instances ORDER BY name

sections.title: Evidence history
sections.sql: SELECT version,health,data_class,reviewer,evidence,valid_until,created_at FROM checks WHERE instance_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
